6517-7084-7272.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least four card types in your graveyard.
You control another nonland creature.
6517-7084-7272.description:
Activate Reaper of Flight Moonsilver by sacrificing another nonland creature you control
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve Reaper of Flight Moonsilver's ability, giving it +2/+1 until end of turn.
Activate Reaper of Flight Moonsilver by sacrificing the land
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Dragonback Assault triggers, creating a 4/4 red Dragon creature token with flying
Resolve Reaper of Flight Moonsilver's ability, giving it +2/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat.

4279-6094-6255--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
4279-6094-6255--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Vengeful Bloodwitch, Zahur and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Vengeful Bloodwitch trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Zahur ability, creating a tapped 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Vengeful Bloodwitch triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

3532-4997-5078-8176.notablePrerequisites: You control another Merfolk and/or Knight.
3532-4997-5078-8176.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Vodalian Wave-Knight triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each other Merfolk and Knight you control
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

6972-7235-8095.easyPrerequisites: There are at least X total creatures on the battlefield.
6972-7235-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Stag Beetle.
When Stag Beetle dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.

215-2404-4348-7895.notablePrerequisites: You control at least six creatures.
215-2404-4348-7895.description:
Activate Gaea's Cradle by tapping it, adding at least six {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Little Bear to your hand.
Cast Little Bear by paying {2}{G}.
When Little Bear enters, it triggers itself, untapping Ley Druid.
Activate Ley Druid by tapping it, untapping Gaea's Cradle.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite green mana, you may activate Temur Sabertooth any number of times and recast any creatures castable with green mana any number of times, effectively "blinking" your green creatures any number of times.
You may also activate Ley Druid any number of times.

1619-4605-5542-6153-6797.notablePrerequisites: You are able to complete a dungeon.
1619-4605-5542-6153-6797.description:
Complete a dungeon.
Sefris' second ability triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the first trigger, returning up to one other creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, returning Vicious Battlerager from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When Vicious Battlerager enters, it and Preston trigger twice due to Delney.
Holding priority, activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Vicious Battlerager.
Resolve a Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Vicious Battlerager that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Vicious Battlerager token enters, it triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the Vicious Battlerager token triggers, venturing into Undercity twice.
Resolve the second Preston trigger from step 5, creating a token copy of Vicious Battlerager that is a 0/1 Illusion.
Repeat steps 8 and 9 one additional time.
Resolve the first Vicious Battlerager trigger from step 5, venturing into Undercity and completing Undercity.
Repeat from step 2.
1619-4605-5542-6153-6797.notes: You can choose whatever path you desire while venturing through Undercity.

2511-4871-7686.notablePrerequisites: You control four or more Squirrels.
2511-4871-7686.description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur four times by sacrificing four Squirrels.
When the Squirrels die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers four times, creating four Treasure tokens.
Resolve all Bloodflow Connoisseur abilities.
Activate four Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat.

3490-5445-5686-7426.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on Berta.
3490-5445-5686-7426.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Tarrian's Soulcleaver triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Berta.
Berta and Animation Module trigger.
Resolve the Berta trigger, adding {1}.
Resolve the Animation Module trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat

2034-3490-4506-6996.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2034-3490-4506-6996.description:
Gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Auriok Champion triggers, causing you to gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers. Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the The Destined White Mage trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control 
Repeat from step 3.

2906-2981-4907-6989.notablePrerequisites: Your opponents have lost at least 3 life this turn.
2906-2981-4907-6989.description:
Cast Tatterkite from your graveyard by paying {0} due to Rakdos. It won't enter with a finality counter on it due to its static ability.
Activate Megatog by sacrificing Tatterkite.
Repeat.

140-586-5258-5618-5686.description:
Activate Rowan by tapping it.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying at most {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat from step 2

338-2034-3000-5086-5183.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
338-2034-3000-5086-5183.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Triskelavus triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another creature token, adding {C}{C}
Repeat from step 1.

3734-5282-7149.description:
Cast Phyrexian Metamorph by paying its mana cost. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Princess Yue.
Put Phyrexian Metamorph into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Phyrexian Metamorph dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield as a land named Moon. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Wormfang Newt, gaining its abilities.
When Phyrexian Metamorph enters, its first ability triggers, exiling it.
When Phyrexian Metamorph leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Phyrexian Metamorph from exile to the battlefield. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Princess Yue.
Repeat from step 2.

2034-4871-6005-6201-7147.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Wretched Throng, adding {C}{C}.
When Wretched Throng dies, it and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Holding priority, activate Malevolent Chandelier by paying {2}, putting Wretched Throng from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Wretched Throng trigger, putting Wretched Throng from your library into your hand.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Cast Wretched Throng by paying {U} due to Sunscape Familiar.
Repeat.

527-1409-1753.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {3}{G}{U}.
Activate Selvala by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Selvala enters, Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability triggers, repairing it and Selvala.
Repeat.

2478-2511-2866-4986.description:
Cast Mishra's Bauble by paying its mana cost.
Teshar triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Mishra's Bauble by tapping and sacrificing it.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Scrap Trawler.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Mishra's Bauble from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

6556-6867-6884.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two creatures with power 4 or greater.
6556-6867-6884.description:
Cast Appa by paying {W}{W}.
When Appa enters, it triggers, airbending Aang.
Cast Aang from exile by paying {0}.
Appa triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token.
When Aang enters, it triggers, airbending Appa.
Cast Appa from exile by paying {0}.
Repeat from step 2.

1850-4935-5414.description:
Activate Troubled Healer by sacrificing a land.
Play the land from your graveyard.
Repeat.
1850-4935-5414.notes: If the land can tap for mana once it enters the battlefield, you can do so for infinite mana.

5909-6836.description:
Cast Doomsday Excruciator by paying {B}{B}{B}{B}{B}{B}. When it enters, it triggers, exiling all but the bottom six cards of each library.
Activate Memory Vessel by tapping and exiling it, exiling the remainder of each library.
Each opponent will lose the game during their next draw step due to attempting to draw from an empty library.

1434-1486-2136-2972.notablePrerequisites: Orthion does not have summoning sickness.
1434-1486-2136-2972.description:
Activate Orthion's second ability by paying {6}{R}{R}{R} and tapping it, creating five token copies of Ganax.
When the Ganax tokens enter the battlefield, each Ganax triggers five times, creating 25 Treasure tokens.
Activate Magda by sacrificing five Treasures, searching your library for a Dragon card and putting it onto the battlefield.
When the Dragon enters the battlefield, each Ganax triggers, creating six Treasure tokens.
Repeat from step 3 until you have no Dragons remaining in your library.
1434-1486-2136-2972.notes: This combo will make some extra Treasures which you may use to activate Magda's ability a few extra times to fetch a few artifacts.

2459-2538-3676-4052.easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable.
2459-2538-3676-4052.description:
Cast Rograkh either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {0} plus commander tax, if applicable.
Tangleroot triggers, adding {G}.
When Rograkh enters the battlefield, Kindred Discovery triggers.
Holding priority, activate Words of Wind by paying {1}, replacing the next card you draw.
Resolve the Kindred Discovery trigger, causing you to return Rograkh from the battlefield to your hand, and causing each opponent to return a permanent they control from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

282-2034-3094-4404.notablePrerequisites: Delina does not have summoning sickness.
282-2034-3094-4404.description:
Declare Delina as an attacker, triggering its ability, targeting any creature.
Holding priority, activate Lithoform Engine's first ability by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Delina's trigger, with the copy targeting Corridor Monitor.
Resolve the copy of Delina's trigger, creating at least one token copy of Corridor Monitor that is tapped and attacking.
When the Corridor Monitor token(s) enter the battlefield, they trigger, untapping Lithoform Engine and up to one other applicable permanent for each remaining trigger.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Corridor Monitor token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 2.

341-586-2921-5258-5618.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability from step 1, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

1636-1923-4289.manaNeeded: {1} if you control exactly three Merfolk
1636-1923-4289.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three Merfolk without summoning sickness.
1636-1923-4289.description:
Activate at least three Merfolk you control by tapping them, adding at least {2}{W}.
Cast Summon the School by paying {3}{W}, creating two 1/1 Merfolk Wizard creature tokens.
When the Merfolk Wizards enter the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers twice.
Resolve the first trigger, untapping all creatures.
Activate at least three Merfolk you control by tapping them, adding at least {2}{W}.
Resolve the second Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
If needed or desired, activate a Merfolk you control by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Summon the School by tapping four untapped Merfolk you control, returning Summon the School from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat from step 2.
If you control four or more Merfolk that does not have summoning sickness, this combo nets infinite colored mana.

1400-4053-4175.description:
Cast Elephant Grass by paying {G}.
Elephant Grass prevents creatures from attacking you due to Darkest Hour making them all black.
Solemnity prevents age counters from being placed on Elephant Grass.

2060-2313-2854-2908.notablePrerequisites: Showdown of the Skalds has 2 or 3 lore counters on it.
2060-2313-2854-2908.description:
Cast Dream Stalker, putting 2 +1/+1 counter on Crystalline Crawler with Showdown of the Skalds.
Remove 2 +1/+1 counter from Crystalline Crawler to add {1}{U}.
Dream Stalker triggers, returning itself to your hand.
Repeat.

2457-2713-4289-5153.notablePrerequisites: Sunstrike Legionnaire does not have summoning sickness.
2457-2713-4289-5153.description:
Tap Sunstrike Legionnaire to add {G}.
Pay {G} to create a 1/1 Insect token.
Sunstrike Legionnaire triggers, untapping.
Repeat.

1530-5022.notablePrerequisites:
You have 5 or less life.
Opponents can not kill Treasury Thrull when you attack.
Treasury Thrull does not have summoning sickness.
1530-5022.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, sacrifice Second Chance and take an extra turn.
Attack with Treasury Thrull, returning Second Chance from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Second Chance.
Pass the turn.
Repeat.

1228-4227.notablePrerequisites:
Gorgon Flail attached to Goblin Sharpshooter.
Goblin Sharpshooter does not have summoning sickness.
1228-4227.description:
Activate Goblin Sharpshooter by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to target creature.
That creature dies from lethal damage due to Goblin Sharpshooter's deathtouch ability.
Goblin Sharpshooter triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat for each creature opponents control and whenever an opponent controls a creature.
